policy.nutrition: No generated nutrition. Migration invokes build_food_catalog_source_snapshot for each exact release and source ID.
policy.selection: Broad category floors are followed by bounded round-robin variants of accepted common identities; no lower-priority one-record heading is introduced during target fill.
policy.aliases: Bounded morphology with uncountable exceptions; equivalent existing identities append variants without changing their defaults or aliases.
policy.confidence: Acceptance is the conjunction of acceptanceEvidence assertions, never a numeric confidence score.
policy.consumerGate: 35 source records rejected because canonical live-helper snapshots failed the strict mobile parser; newly added bounded variants require the next read-only preflight before apply.
